name: Demos/Demas
title: Paul's coworker who left him
summary: Demas was one of the apostle Paul's coworkers in preaching the gospel. He is first mentioned as a faithful helper, but later became known for leaving Paul because he loved this present world. His story stands as a warning about the danger of putting worldly things before service to Christ.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Paul's coworker
keyEvents.description: Demas is mentioned together with Luke as one of Paul's coworkers in the letter to Philemon, written during Paul's first imprisonment in Rome.

keyEvents.title: Sends greetings to the Colossians
keyEvents.description: In the letter to the Colossians, Demas sends his greetings to the church, showing that he was active in the work alongside Paul at this time.

keyEvents.title: Demas Leaves Paul for Love of the World
keyEvents.description: In 2 Timothy, Paul writes with sorrow that Demas has left him because he loved the present world and went to Thessalonica. This happened during Paul's second imprisonment.
